Title: Check-out date earlier than check-in is accepted
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open any hotel and click Book now 2. Set check-in to 20 Dec and check-out to 18 Dec 3. Submit the form
Observed Behavior: Booking is saved with a negative stay length

Title: Email field accepts text without an @ symbol
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open the booking form 2. Enter guest.example.com as the email 3. Submit
Observed Behavior: Form submits and the value is stored

Title: Same venue can be booked twice on one date
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Book Venue A for 14 Feb 2. In a second session book Venue A for 14 Feb 3. Complete checkout in both sessions
Observed Behavior: Both bookings are saved for the same venue and date

Title: Booking total excludes selected add-ons
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Select a venue priced at 10000 2. Add a sound system priced at 1500 3. Open the booking summary
